description: This file defines the AddressFormat model class used in the Opencart e-commerce system. It provides a method to retrieve address format records from the database based on an address format ID.

classes.name: AddressFormat
classes.description: A model class responsible for fetching address format data from the database in the Opencart system.

methods.name: getAddressFormat
methods.description: Retrieves the address format record from the database given its ID.
